rubrics.criterion: Changing the park charge, participation, taxpayer basis, admission, or eligibility immediately recalculates budget and attendance outcomes
Changing cutoff frequency or resonance updates coefficients, pole values, stability, and the native impulse-response plot from the same filter model
Context search returns truthful bundled facts for supported terms and an honest empty state for unsupported terms without leaving the app
Read, Scenario, Filter, and Context remain reachable through persistent native bottom navigation in portrait and landscape
The app uses native Compose cards, controls, navigation, typography, accessibility semantics, and Canvas rendering without a WebView or browser chrome
